text.en: Least-to-most prompting is row 46 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Least-to-most prompting 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 46 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Least-to-most prompting with “Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Least-to-most prompting 与论文《Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Denny Zhou, Ed Chi”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Denny Zhou（官方页拼写）、Ed Chi（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Denny Zhou, Ed Chi”。
